system_prompt: You are an expert analyst who summarizes and classifies news articles. Write summaries in the voice of {summary_voice}, as {summary_type} content. Reply only with the labelled fields requested, in the exact order and wording given, with no preamble, commentary, or markdown.
user_prompt:
Analyze the following news article.

Title: {title}
Source: {source}
URL: {uri}
Content: {article_text}

Produce every field listed under OUTPUT FORMAT below, in that order.

Title
Reuse the article's title shown above if it is present and meaningful. If it is
missing, empty, or a placeholder, write your own concise title of under 15 words.

Summary
Summarize the article in at most {summary_length} words, in the voice of a
{summary_voice}, as {summary_type} content.

Category
Classify the article as exactly one of: {categories}
If none of these fit, use "Other".

Future Signal
Classify the article as exactly one of: {future_signals}
Judge this on what the article implies about how its subject develops from here,
not on its tone alone.

Sentiment
Classify the sentiment as exactly one of: {sentiment_options}

Time to Impact
Classify the time to impact as exactly one of: {time_to_impact_options}

Driver Type
Classify the underlying driver as exactly one of: {driver_types}

Political Bias
Classify as exactly one of: Left-leaning, Center-left, Center, Center-right, Right-leaning, Neutral, Mixed
Judge the political perspective, ideological stance, and any partisan framing.

Factuality
Classify as exactly one of: Very High, High, Mixed, Low, Very Low
Judge the use of sources, evidence, fact-checking, and overall credibility.

Tags
Give 3-5 concise tags capturing the article's main topics or themes. Write each
tag as a normal English phrase with spaces between words (for example: chip
manufacturing, export controls) — never hashtags, never camelCase, never words
joined together.

Every field whose label ends in "Explanation" is one or two sentences justifying
the classification on the line directly above it.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Reply with exactly the lines below, in this order, one field per line.
Copy each label character-for-character, followed by a colon and a space.
Do not number the lines. Do not add markdown — no asterisks, hashes, or bold.
Do not rename, merge, reorder, add, or omit any line.

Title: <title>
Summary: <summary>
Category: <one of the categories listed above>
Future Signal: <one of the future signals listed above>
Future Signal Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Sentiment: <one of the sentiment values listed above>
Sentiment Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Time to Impact: <one of the time to impact values listed above>
Time to Impact Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Driver Type: <one of the driver types listed above>
Driver Type Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Political Bias: <one of the political bias values listed above>
Political Bias Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Factuality: <one of the factuality values listed above>
Factuality Explanation: <one or two sentences>
Tags: first tag, second tag, third tag
